answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 5 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the lotus count is verified against the lantern text itself, the jade audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 95 aliases thus means producing 95 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 5 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
